description.narrative: Expected Project-level outcomes are contribution to the value addition to the operating countries economy and creation jobs in countries with high unemployment rates and positive environmental effects driven largely by climate adaptation measures and mitigation measures. In addition, part of the investment will be used towards earthquake strengthening works in the existing factories in Istanbul (Topkapi, Gebze) which are expected to result in enhancement in safety standards and creation of temporary construction employment opportunities. Beyond the Project level, IFC expects the investment to increase the resilience of the sector through adoption of sustainability measures and improving buildings to withstand earthquakes. Finally, investment in Kazakhstan Hamle factory will cover process enhancements and technological adjustments which are expected to lead to greater efficiency in resource utilization as well as improvement of safety environment at the factory.

IFC committed a EUR75 million A-Loan on March 29, 2024, to Ülker Biskuvi Sanayi A.S. (Ülker). The IFC Loan will support Ülkers multi-year corporate investment program. IFC also had an approval to invest EUR75 million, by subscribing to a US$-denominated senior unsecured fixed rate Eurobond to be issued by Ülker. As a result of the book building that took place on July 1, 2024, IFC has been allocated US$65 million of the notes issued (the IFC Subscription). Proceeds of the IFC Subscription will be used to refinance working capital needs of Ülkers facilities located in Topkapi and Gebze in Türkiye, and its subsidiary Hamle`s factory in Kazakhstan.
